interpretation.goal: Tighten the fasteners of the variant F30 forklift at station st2 on line 2 using a manual torque wrench.
constraints: The tightening must be done with the manual torque wrench the operator asked for, not silently replaced by the nutrunner NR7.
The tightening program (bolt count, target torque, tolerance) for F30 must come from get-program at run time and never appear as literals (E4).
Every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability (E5).
Any shared tool used must be reserved, renewed before each physical use and released (E1, E6).
